identification.summary: TStark is the label for a threat actor device/cluster described by Sophos X-Ops in its Pacific Rim reporting; per Malpedia's summary, files recovered included macOS and iOS malware and IFRAME injection code exploiting a WebAssembly vulnerability, and telemetry suggested intermittent VPN use switching between Hong Kong and Chengdu IP addresses [S3]. The name appears to be a device/handle label rather than a named vendor threat group.
identification.notes: Device details come from Malpedia's secondary summary of the Sophos report; the primary Sophos timeline page was not confirmed. Do not merge with Volt Typhoon, APT31 or APT41 clusters; Sophos only described TTP overlaps [S4].

attribution.basis: Sophos X-Ops assessed with medium confidence the existence of a research community centred on educational establishments in Chengdu, and attributed specific clusters of Pacific Rim activity, with varying confidence, to Volt Typhoon, APT31 and APT41/Winnti [S4]. No source seen attributes TStark itself to a state sponsor.

targeting.notes: TStark was described as an adversary-side device rather than a victim-facing actor in sources seen. Wider Pacific Rim activity targeted Sophos perimeter firewalls [S4].

capabilities.summary: Per Malpedia, files associated with TStark included macOS and iOS malware and IFRAME injection code exploiting a WebAssembly vulnerability [S3].

campaigns.name: Sophos publishes Pacific Rim report
campaigns.summary: Sophos disclosed its multi-year investigation into China-based actors targeting network devices [S4].

campaigns.name: US action on Sichuan Silence and Guan Tianfeng
campaigns.summary: Press reported US charges against Guan Tianfeng of Sichuan Silence over exploitation of Sophos firewalls, and Treasury sanctions; this is related context and no source seen links it to TStark [S2].

diamond.adversary: Unattributed operator behind the TStark device; Hong Kong/Chengdu VPN IPs [S3].
diamond.capability: macOS and iOS malware; WebAssembly-based IFRAME injection [S3].

gaps: Original Sophos Pacific Rim timeline URL could not be confirmed and was removed; TStark device details rest on Malpedia's secondary summary and should be verified against Sophos.
Malpedia also cites CVE-2020-15069 and libsophos.so; not independently verified here.
Discovery date of the TStark device unconfirmed.
No state sponsor, objectives, victims or infrastructure established.
Relationship to Sichuan Silence, Double Helix and Volt Typhoon/APT31/APT41 clusters unconfirmed.
Aliases and MITRE group id unknown.
